purpose.zh-Hant: 先辨認尺寸與單位，再連接面積、體積及相似比例。
purpose.en: Identify dimensions and units, then connect areas, volumes and similarity ratios.

prerequisites.zh-Hant: 單位換算、面積／體積、畢氏定理及相似。
prerequisites.en: Unit conversion, areas and volumes, Pythagoras’ theorem and similarity.

scopeNote.zh-Hant: 本頁提供基本方法導讀及現有題庫入口；進階分支與完整圖解會繼續補充，並非完整課綱或全章筆記。
scopeNote.en: This is a foundational method guide and an entry to the published bank. Advanced branches and complete visual explanations are still being developed; this is not a complete syllabus or chapter note.

intro.zh-Hant: 長度、面積及體積的單位次方不同。面積是平方單位，體積是立方單位；圖中的垂直高度不一定等於斜高。
intro.en: Length, area and volume use different powers of units. Area uses square units and volume uses cubic units. Perpendicular height is not necessarily slant height.

trigger.zh-Hant: 先圈出半徑、直徑、垂直高及角度，再選所需面積或體積。
trigger.en: Identify radius, diameter, perpendicular height and angle before choosing an area or volume formula.

trap.zh-Hant: 扇形公式此處用度數；題目若用弧度須改用相應公式。
trap.en: This sector formula uses degrees. Use the appropriate formula if the angle is in radians.

intro.zh-Hant: 圓錐體積用垂直高 h；曲面積用斜高 l。組合立體先判斷哪些面外露，黏合面不重複計算。
intro.en: Cone volume uses perpendicular height h; curved surface area uses slant height l. For composites, identify exposed surfaces and omit joined internal faces.

trigger.zh-Hant: 截去或挖空部分以相減處理；熔鑄或液體轉移先寫體積守恆。
trigger.en: Subtract removed or hollow portions. For recasting or liquid transfer, start with conservation of volume.

trap.zh-Hant: 圓錐總表面積包含底面，開口或黏合時未必需要計底面。
trap.en: Total cone area includes the base, but an open or joined base may not be exposed.

title.zh-Hant: 相似：長度、面積、體積分開
title.en: Similarity: separate length, area and volume

intro.zh-Hant: 相似圖形的對應長度比為 k，面積比為 k²；相似立體體積比為 k³。先證明相似，再套比例。
intro.en: If corresponding lengths in similar figures have ratio k, areas have ratio k²; similar solids have volume ratio k³. Establish similarity before applying these ratios.

trigger.zh-Hant: 地圖比例先統一長度單位；平面三角形面積比先找共底或共高。
trigger.en: For map scales, unify length units first. For triangle area ratios, look for a shared base or height.

trap.zh-Hant: 只有面積或體積相等不代表相似；非相似立體不能直接套立方比例。
trap.en: Equal areas or volumes do not imply similarity. Do not apply cubic scaling to non-similar solids.
